scope: authoritative drought/resilience source inventory for Puerto Rico

sources.role: station precipitation and temperature observations; historical denominator
sources.notes: Use station metadata and quality flags; freeze exact query, retrieval UTC, response bytes and SHA256 before episode computation.

sources.role: daily values and discrete field measurements for streamflow, groundwater and related observations
sources.notes: Respect parameter semantics: depth-to-water and elevation-above-datum can have opposite concerning directions.

sources.role: 2015 reservoir-level comparison for Lago Loiza, Lago La Plata and Lago Toa Vaca; includes PRASA operating-level references
sources.notes: Do not OCR graph values unless machine-readable source cannot be recovered; prefer underlying USGS station series.

sources.role: weekly spatial drought classifications and historical archive
sources.notes: USDM class is a composite product; preserve it as its own observation and do not substitute it for independently computed drought classes.

sources.authority: Puerto Rico Department of Natural and Environmental Resources
sources.role: dated 2015 operational statement on inflows and USGS streamflow conditions during rationing
sources.notes: Contains quoted aggregate conditions; underlying station series remain preferred for quantitative reconstruction.

sources.authority: Puerto Rico Department of Natural and Environmental Resources
sources.role: dated 2015 statement linking aquifer conditions with weekly drought-monitor percentages
sources.notes: Use as institutional observation and cross-check against USDM archive plus well records.

sources.authority: Puerto Rico Department of Consumer Affairs
sources.role: official drought-related price-freeze response associated with possible water rationing
sources.notes: Bind exact signed/order PDF when freezing.

sources.authority: Puerto Rico Department of Consumer Affairs
sources.role: official rescission after cessation of the water rationing plan on 2015-10-25
sources.notes: Use to bound a response intervention, not the meteorological or hydrological drought interval.

sources.role: 2015 withdrawals/use by source and category; annual demand context
sources.notes: Annual estimates cannot establish daily shortage timing; use only at matching temporal granularity.

sources.role: Puerto Rico-specific drought taxonomy, historical context, SPI/PDI discussion and reservoir-storage context
sources.notes: Methodology/context source; do not substitute narrative figures for frozen raw observations when raw series exist.
